{{Quote|The repulsorlift generators are more than sufficient for keeping this skyhook aloft. Don't worry about that.|[[Asyr Sei'lar]] to [[Gavin Darklighter]]|<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
A '''repulsorlift generator''' was an anti-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] device that relied on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift technology]]. They were used in many models of vehicles and on [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhooks]] to keep them afloat.<ref name="KT" />
